main.description: Lists actors whose indexed follow records name the requested actor as subject. Authentication is not required. Duplicate relationships are collapsed before pagination.

actor.description: DID of the actor whose incoming follows are listed. Required.

sortDirection.description: Sort by each representative follow's createdAt and URI in this direction; the default is desc.

limit.description: Maximum relationships returned; the handler default is 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page, bound to sortDirection. Keep other query parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A required DID, sort direction, limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid.

followers.description: Incoming relationships, with each displayed DID identifying the actor who published the follow.

totalCount.description: Number of matching relationships after duplicate relationships are collapsed, before cursor and limit are applied.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there are no more relationships.
